question_text: A 23-year-old woman is brought to the emergency department by her friend because of strange behavior. Two hours ago, she was at a night club where she got involved in a fight with the bartender. Her friend says that she was smoking a cigarette before she became irritable and combative. She repeatedly asked “Why are you pouring blood in my drink?” before hitting the bartender. She has no history of psychiatric illness. Her temperature is 38°C (100.4°F), pulse is 100/min, respirations are 19/min, and blood pressure is 158/95 mm Hg. Examination shows muscle rigidity. She has a reduced degree of facial expression. She has no recollection of her confrontation with the bartender. Which of the following is the most likely primary mechanism responsible for this patient's symptoms?
